items.name: Party Platter (5-6pax) Korean Fried Chicken Boneless
items.description: Get your Chimaek Party started with our Korean fried chicken party platter. Feeds 5-6pax, Our Korean fried chicken is boneless, using our batter, and its double fried to ensure it’s crispy. Choose from our signature in house made sauces. Enjoy your party.

items.name: PARTY PLATTER(5-6pax) Gimbaps
items.description: Get your party started with our Gimbap Platter: each platters feed 5-6persons. Gimbap flavours are Original x 2, Spam x 2, Bulgogi x 1. If you do not take Beef, please let us know via the remarks. Enjoy your party.

items.name: Party Platter (3-4pax) Kimchi Fried Rice with eggs
items.description: Get your party started with our kimchi fried rice platters. This platter feeds 3-4pax. Enjoy your party.

items.name: NEW!!! Signature Donkatsu with purple rice
items.description: Annyeong ^^ This is Koreans all time favourite go to comfort food. Featuring a generous sized breaded panko pork katsu, with purple rice and donkatsu sauce. Comes with 1 banchan of the day as a side. Highly recommend, we ensured the size of the katsu is big. Please enjoy your meal.

items.name: MKMK Original Gimbap 김밥
items.description: Korean ricerolls(Gimbap) handrolled expertly into artistic masterpieces by my korean mom and delivered right to your doorstep. You see it in every korean drama, kids, adults, everyone loves it. Its perfect for a netflix and chill, WFH or even a family picnic!

items.name: Eggroll Vegetarian Gimbap 김밥
items.description: THE CROWD FAVOURITE: Korean Eggrolls (Gyeran mari) ricerolls(Gimbap) handrolled expertly into artistic masterpieces by my korean mom and delivered right to your doorstep.

items.name: Soy Garlic Fried Chicken Katsu Gimbap 김밥
items.description: Its savory, super delicious, and incredibly addictive. Korean ricerolls(Gimbap) handrolled expertly fried chicken with our signature Soy Garlic sauce into artistic masterpieces by my korean mom and delivered right to your doorstep.

items.name: Spicy Gochujang Fried Chicken Katsu Gimbap 김밥
items.description: This creation is inspired by the korean fried chicken sensation in seoul.Korean ricerolls(Gimbap) handrolled expertly fried chicken served with our signature Gochujang sauce into artistic masterpieces by my korean mom and delivered right to your doorstep

items.name: Spam Luncheon Gimbap 김밥
items.description: Crowd favourite spam(chicken), this combination is simply a matchmake in heaven. Its savory, super delicious, and incredibly addictive. Korean ricerolls(Gimbap) handrolled expertly with fried chicken spam into artistic masterpieces by my korean mom and delivered right to your doorstep.

items.name: American Cheese Gimbap 김밥
items.description: Korean ricerolls(Gimbap) handrolled expertly with chicken Vienna sausage & premium cheddar cheese into artistic masterpieces by my korean mom and delivered right to your doorstep.

items.name: Bulgogi Beef Gimbap 김밥
items.description: A classic crowd favourite flavour and a must try. Its savory, sweet and served with tender ribeye beef that melts in your mouth.

items.name: Ebi Prawn Gimbap 김밥
items.description: 2 x Fried Ebi Prawn Tempuras handrolled expertly into artistic masterpieces by my korean mom and delivered right to your doorstep

items.name: Meat Lovers Gimbap (No veg) 김밥
items.description: Meat lovers!! Here you go, this one’s for you. 1 large Chicken Vienna sausage, along with spam luncheon meat(Chicken), with rice, yellow radish, eggs and burdock. super savoury and incredibly addictive!

items.name: Potato Jeon (Pancake)
items.description: This is our newly created item. Potato Jeon Pancake. You don’t usually find them easily in Singapore. Hence we have decided to bring it for yall to savour. Great as a complement to your main Korean classic dishes.

items.name: NEW!! Chive Jeon (Pancake)
items.description: One of our most popular sharing sides at our restaurant. Using in house marinates and batter, we pan fry our jeons to create an addictive flavour. Contains Seafood

items.name: Jajang Myeong (Blackbean Noodles)
items.description: Handmade Noodles with Caramalized onions stir fried with our homemade blackbean paste sauce. This is one of the crowd favourite and highly popular takeaway food in Korea.

items.name: Jajang Bap (Blackbean sauce with Purple Rice)
items.description: Our homemade black bean paste sauce filled with tons of caramalized onions, meat and super savoury. Paired with our signature purple rice.

items.name: Signature Kimchi Jjigae/Stew w Purple Rice 김치찌개
items.description: Koreans love our soup, and im telling y’all, my korean moms kimchi jjigae(soup) is simply amazing! Boiled overnight with lots of our aged signature kimchi, along with many secret ingredients, slowly extracting all the essence to create the tastiest kimchi jjigae/soup

items.name: Sundubu Jjigae – Spicy Soft Tofu Stew w Purple Rice 순두부찌개
items.description: Koreans love our soup, and im telling y’all, my korean moms Sundubu Jjigae – Spicy Soft Tofu Stew (순두부찌개) is simply amazing! Boiled overnight with lots of our aged signature kimchi, along with many secret ingredients, slowly extracting all the essence to create the tastiest kimchi jjigae/soup

items.name: Yukgaejang – Spicy Beef Stew w Purple Rice 육개장
items.description: Koreans love our soup, and im telling y’all, my korean moms Yugaejang spicy beef jjigae(soup) is simply amazing! Boiled overnight with lots of our aged signature kimchi, and beef, along with many secret ingredients, slowly extracting all the essence to create the tastiest Yugaejang.

items.name: Army Stew w Purple Rice (Sausage,Spam&Ham)부대찌개
items.description: The ultimate Budae Jjigae(Army stew)부대찌개 experience and we don’t say this lightly! You don’t need to join the army to savour this one, we promise. One of the most highly requested dish by our customers, and with such a tall order, we dug deep and took many attempts to perfect our Budae Jjigae.

items.name: Korean Fried Chicken (Boneless) 닭강정 MUST TRY!!
items.description: Do you love Korean fried chicken? 5 different flavours to choose from!This dish is great as an appetiser, Great for Kids, perfect to share, MKMK has brought it to your door steps. Fried chicken chunks, made with our secret recipe, double fried for crispiness.

items.name: Signature Kimchi Pancakes Jeon전 MUST TRY!!
items.description: One of our signature dish, a hot favourite at our restaurant. Cripsy kimchi pancakes using our signature aged kimchi and our home made batter. Perfect for sharing!

items.name: Fried Mandu Dumplings (5pcs)
items.description: Fried Mandu Dumplings. A must have sides to complement your other Korean dishes.

items.name: Tteokbokki Korean Spicy Ricecakes w Fishcakes 떡볶이
items.description: Most iconic k street food! Our version come with spicy, slightly sweet, and chewy rice cakes are simply addictive, paired with Korean fish cakes Eomuk-guk, 어묵국. Made with korean anchovies, kelp, carrots, onions and radish, and afterwhich enhanced with our homemade gochujang sauce.

items.name: Doenjang Jjigae (Korean Miso Stew)
items.description: Our Doenjang Jjigae is savoury, filled with tofu, vegetables and comes with purple rice. This stew is mildly light spiced. Highly recommended. Korean Miso soup.

items.name: MKMK Kimchi Cabbage김치 (Signature) 450g
items.description: Kimchi cabbage 450g made fresh by my korean mom’s hands, tossed with our secret spicy gochugaru sauce, fermented lightly, bottled and delivered right to your doorstep. With the right refrigeration conditions,  we recommend finishing our kimchi within a month.

items.name: Anchovies with peanuts in signature sauce(non spicy)
items.description: The most tasty of all banchans! , made fresh daily by my korean mom’s hands, tossed with our secret soy sauce, packed and delivered right to your doorstep. We use korean premium small anchovies, even though it is more expensive to procure, the bigger anchovies just cannot compete

items.name: Korean Seasoned Dried Radish – Mumallaengi Muchim (무말랭이무침) 200g
items.description: Mumallaengi-muchim is a traditional Korean banchan of dried radish marinated in a gochujang-spiked dressing. when you bite into the radish, it is crunchy with many layers of flavours, sweet, salty, spicy and very addictive. Pair this with rice, ramyeon and simply every meal

items.name: Spicy Dried Squid
items.description: One of the absolute crowd favourite. We use dried Korean squid mixed with our signature spicy and sweet Gochujang homemade sauce. Very tasty and goes well with any meal!

items.name: Shortgrain Purple Rice
items.description: Need more rice? Add this on.

items.name: Signature Donkatsu (Katsu only)
items.description: Our signature Donkatsu Katsu. Pork cutlet, large pork katsu marinated and battered with Japanese panko crumbs, then deep fried to perfection.
